resources.string: Start with an audio file you can use, or add built-in drums in BEAT. You can close this guide and explore at any time.
Choose a file or open a saved project. SOURCE lets you listen to the original. Importing keeps its original bytes; it does not place the whole recording in your song.
Choose a range in the original and assign it to a PAD. BANK A–H each hold 16 PADs. Change the start, end and playing mode from the PAD settings.

Play the PADs, then place the sounds on the song timeline. The PAD details open step/pattern editing. You can also record your voice and open Lyrics here. The original and song have separate play and volume controls.
Save a project to keep editable sounds and arrangements, or export WAV to share the finished mix. Autosave helps you resume on this device; save a project for a separate copy. Undo reverses an edit.

Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move focus, then Enter or Space to press a focused button. Focused PADs use Enter or Space; arrow keys move a focused clip. Escape closes this guide. Android screen readers can use each PAD’s labeled actions. Stop all stays available while you work.
Open “How to use Earth Song” in SOURCE to read this again. This guide does not request microphone permission, download audio or start playback.
